name: Waves of Time knocks back an enemy 30 degrees off the Chronomancer's facing (#12342)
contract: Waves of Time 801277 blasts "enemies in a frontal cone"; its knockback 802600 (Effect 98, EffectBasePoints 69,
EffectMiscValue 150) targets TARGET_UNIT_CONE_ENEMY_24 with radius index 13 = 10 yd and is cast at cast time by
spell_ascension_waves_of_time. Without a spell_cone row the core read the enum suffix as a 24 degree arc (+/-12),
so enemies in front of the caster but slightly to the side were missed, as #12342 reports. The spell_cone rows
restore 90 degrees (+/-45), as for Flames of Xoroth, Dreadwake, Dawnbreak, Spirit Glaive and Crush. The harness
places the dummy along +x, so the Chronomancer turns in place. CONTROL: facing 70 degrees away the dummy stays
put through both knockbacks. DISCRIMINATING: facing 30 degrees away (outside 12, inside 45) the dummy, 4 yd
away, is pushed at least 2 yd within 900 ms, before the 2 s repeat.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Turn: CONTROL 70 degrees away from the dummy
Cover the cast-time knockback and the 2 s repeat
CONTROL: the dummy outside the 45 degree half-angle is not knocked back
Turn: DISCRIMINATING 30 degrees away from the dummy
DISCRIMINATING: the dummy 30 degrees off the facing is knocked back at once
